resources.string: "%1$s · %2$s · Refresh manually for the latest data"
"Local time when recorded · Most active %1$s, %2$s times"
"%1$s · %2$s · %3$s\nBased on these chart statistics. Reanalyze after refreshing or changing the range; AI is not requested automatically."

"Only tapping the button below sends this range\'s charts, preceding-period and 7/30-day comparisons, profile metrics, associations, and your purpose of use, including creator, topic, and module-feature rankings, to the selected model: %1$s. Routine collection stays local and does not request AI. Results remain only on this page.\nAI judgments are for reference. Chart statistics do not represent actual watch time."

"Export one long PNG image or PDF, then choose where to share it. It includes the complete report, rankings, recent records, and existing AI results without another AI request. %1$s Review visible creators, topics, and self-description. Choose PDF if the image is too long."
"Complete PDF generated (%1$s pages). Choose where to share it."

"%1$s

Encountering content does not by itself establish liking it. Gaps do not mean no use; automatic triggers are not deliberate choices.
This is not a psychological assessment and does not infer occupation, health, politics, or stable personality."
"Color represents views. Outlined cells have no retained events, possibly because collection was off or incomplete. %1$s"
"%1$s topics identified with %2$s tag occurrences. A post may have multiple topics. Tags are neither distinct posts nor self-reported interests."
"Encountered %1$s identifiable creators. Posts encountered again across days account for %2$s. Repeated exposure may come from recommendations, not deliberate following or rewatching."

"Counted in local time when events occurred. Night (0–5 h) accounts for %1$s and weekends %2$s. The range may contain different numbers of weekdays and weekend days. This does not represent sleep or daily routine."
"%1$s lacks comparable topic records, so no topic change is inferred. Collection gaps or unidentified topics do not mean no interest."
"Current %1$s — %2$s: %3$s views, %4$s feature triggers.\nPrevious %5$s — %6$s: %7$s views, %8$s feature triggers.\n%9$s"
"%1$s visible segments; %2$s ended, with %3$s confirmed visible time. Dwell time does not establish complete viewing or liking; automatic actions are marked separately."
"%1$s · %2$s\nAnalysis generated %3$s\nThe following concerns only the snapshot used for that request and is for reference."
"Recorded only on this device · Disable or clear anytime"
"Optional: add your purpose and feedback, and view recording notes"

"Off by default. Posts, creators, topics, and feature usage are recorded only locally. Excluded from settings backups by default; include them explicitly if desired. Summaries last 365 days and association details at most 30 days. Summaries are sent only when you request AI. Disabling collection keeps records; clear them anytime."
"Unable to read local records. Tap Refresh to check. The switch above shows the recording state."
"Deletes browsing, feature-use records, purpose of use, and feedback across all ranges. This cannot be undone. The recording switch keeps its current state."
"For example: relax, learn photography, or find cooking ideas. May be blank."
"Your own description helps distinguish actions from motives. It is saved locally and sent only with an AI analysis you explicitly request."

"Only posts actually shown after recording is enabled are counted. Repeat encounters add views; distinct posts are deduplicated by post ID. Feature counts represent integrated actual triggers, not the number of enabled switches."
"No records in this range yet. Browse posts or use module features, then tap Refresh."
"No records yet. Enable the switch above to start collecting. Past browsing is not backfilled."
"Tap a point on the line to see its count"

"Live means motion photos. A mixed photo post with any motion photos counts once as a motion-photo post. Long videos are at least 5 minutes. Unrecognized content is Unknown/Other. LIVE cards are separate and do not establish entering a LIVE room or watch duration."
"No topic records; posts without topics are excluded from this ranking"

"Active days and streaks use retained records in the selected range. Blank dates may reflect disabled or incomplete collection. A current streak allows today to have no record yet. The first record is measured since the last clear and may be older than 365 days."
"Analysis canceled. You can request it again."
"Choose an available AI profile. Following global requires an enabled global model."
"No data to analyze in this range. Analysis becomes available after records are collected."
"Images are saved to Pictures/TokAi and PDFs to Downloads/TokAi."
"Choose where to save the report file."
"This model and secondary prompt are only for local analytics. Blank uses the default prompt; report structure and statistical definitions remain."
"Unable to read model profiles. Check AI model settings."
"Analysis did not complete. Try again later."
"Unable to open sharing. Long press the analysis text to copy it."
"Complete long PNG generated. Choose where to share it."
"Unable to open sharing. The report was not shared; try again."
"The content is long. Choose PDF to export the complete report."
"Report generation or saving failed. Choose PDF for an overly long image, or check the location or reduce the range and retry. Report content is unchanged."
"View counts and topic changes between periods"
"Browsing trend. Tap to choose a date; accessibility clicks cycle through dates."
"A temporary profile assembled from local activity records"
"Not enough records to describe you yet. Continued use will reveal content, rhythm, and tool patterns."
"What this profile knows and does not know"
"Select a date to see views and feature counts"
"Showing the latest 84 days in the selected range."
"Each row totals 100%; bands show the period\'s content mix"
"Each row totals 100%; tap a band for raw counts"
"Compares recorded content mix; empty rows mean missing records. Live means motion photos; videos at least 5 minutes count as long."
"No identifiable topics. This cannot establish how broad your interests are."
"Area represents occurrences; full names and counts are listed below"
"Area represents occurrences; select a tile for its full name"
"No identifiable creators; exposure sources cannot yet be described."
"Sorted by occurrences; the curve shows cumulative share"
"Shading represents records by weekday and hour"
"Select a cell for its count; accessibility clicks cycle through cells"
"Coverage is incomplete; no increase or decrease is inferred."
"Gray is previous, blue current; each item has its own scale"

"Shows leading topic ranks and counts in both periods. Absence from the summary is not zero. Today is incomplete and counts depend on collection coverage. Ranking shifts do not directly establish changed interests."
"No associated records yet. Separate night, topic, and save counts cannot be combined into one action."
"Topics and times within the same encounter"
"Time means the visible segment\'s starting hour; each may have multiple topics. This is not dwell-duration distribution."
"Content and actions within the same encounter"
"Cumulative creator share; other creators are grouped"
"Period comparison dot chart; independent scale per row"
"Report exceeds the long-image size limit. Choose PDF for the complete content."
"Report exceeds the PDF page limit. Reduce the statistics range."
"Unable to paginate the complete report. Reduce the statistics range."
"Report text is too large to paginate completely"
"Unable to finish saving the report file"
"Views represent integrated content encounters. Distinct posts use local identifiers for deduplication. Feature counts mean triggers, not successful requests."
"No retained records in this range. A gap does not mean no use."

"Live means motion photos. A mixed post with motion photos counts as one motion-photo post. Long videos are at least 5 minutes. Unidentified content is unknown or other. LIVE cards do not establish entering a LIVE room or watch duration."
"Counted by local event time, not sleep, actual watch duration, or daily routine."
"Local statistics come from integrated records collected on this device while enabled. Gaps do not mean no use, views are not actual watch time, and feature triggers are not successful requests."

"Charts are local statistics. AI interpretations come from the request identified in the report, not a new analysis. Distinguish content exposure, automatic behavior, and deliberate preferences. This is not a psychological assessment and does not infer occupation, health, politics, or stable personality."
"Before sharing, review creators, topics, recent records, and AI text, which may quote your purpose or self-description. No database, API settings, or keys are attached."
"AI generated · Read separately from local statistics"
"This report has no AI results yet. Export did not request AI."
"Samples across days, still limited by coverage"
"More cross-day samples; still only recorded behavior"
"Full creator-distribution evenness %1$s; full topic-distribution evenness %2$s; %3$s topic occurrences."
"This is recommendation-feed exposure structure. Posts may have multiple topics, and topic shares use all topic occurrences as their denominator. This does not prove liking."
"More distinct creators and topics are needed to compare source and topic distributions."
"Creators are more evenly distributed than topics: broader sources with relatively concentrated themes."
"Topics are at least as evenly distributed as creators; themes and exposure sources have different dispersion."
"%1$s accounts for %2$s of this period\'s records; %3$s content formats were observed."
"%1$s view records, %2$s distinct posts; leading type %3$s."
"Motion-photo posts and LIVE cards are counted separately. Content length is not watch duration, and format cannot establish engagement."
"Browsing was recorded on %1$s days; early morning accounts for %2$s and weekends %3$s."
"Early morning is 00:00–05:59; weekends are Saturday and Sunday. Both use this period\'s %1$s view records as denominator."
"Separate time and topic shares cannot be combined into liking a topic late at night. Weekend share is not normalized by weekday/weekend day counts."
"%1$s posts appeared again on different dates, accounting for %2$s of distinct posts."
"Repeated across days %1$s / distinct posts %2$s; %3$s total views."
"Repeats may come from recommendations, deliberate returns, or different entries. This is not an intentional rewatch rate and cannot reconstruct save intent."
"%1$s module feature events: %2$s manual entries and %3$s automatic triggers."
"%1$s events have unknown sources. Feature and view counts are separate."
"Entry, request, acceptance, and success are distinct stages, not directly task counts. Automatic actions do not establish deliberate approval."
"Current: %1$s views and %2$s feature events; equally long previous period: %3$s and %4$s. %5$s"
"Previous coverage is insufficient; no growth or decline is inferred."
"This period includes today\'s incomplete records; changes will continue."
"The leading topic is %1$s; the equally long preceding period\'s was %2$s. %3$s"
"Previous coverage is incomplete. Recorded content is shown side by side without inferring preference changes."
"Changes in the leader reflect exposure structure, not necessarily changed interests."
"%1$s to %2$s → %3$s to %4$s. Rankings use all topic records; posts may have multiple topics."
"%1$s This period includes unfinished today. Tail entries are grouped as Other; absence from rankings does not mean never encountered."
"Captured %1$s visible segments in the retained range, totaling %2$s confirmed visible seconds."
"Only bounded samples while foreground, visible, and still on the same post accumulate. Segments are not distinct posts."
"Visibility is not attention or liking. Old data are not backfilled; background, occlusion, and heartbeat gaps are excluded. Each segment is capped at 30 minutes."
"Statistics window %1$s to %2$s; today is incomplete. Views include repeat encounters. Blank days may mean no use, collection disabled, or missing coverage."
"Daily summaries last up to 365 days. Associated visible segments last 30 days, at most 20,000 segments and 30,000 actions. Associations are not fabricated from old summaries."

"Dwell is focused foreground visibility sampling, not guaranteed detection of same-window occlusion or actual attention, and not complete viewing or liking. Checkpoints save about every 3 seconds; termination may lose an unsaved tail. Segments are capped at 30 minutes."
"Topic shares use all occurrences as denominator; one post may have multiple topics. Creator/topic evenness uses full distributions, not only Top 10."
"Identified-creator records %1$s / total views %2$s. Unknown creators are excluded from creator counts, evenness, and concentration. Creator shares use identified-creator records as denominator."
"Manual, automatic, system, and unknown sources are separate. Older feature events have unknown sources. Action stages are counted separately, not directly as distinct tasks."
"Time associations use segment start hours. Charts show the top 48 groups actually recorded within the same segment. Unassociated actions still count as features but not in post-association charts."
"Earliest traceable record: %1$s. Earlier unrecorded dates cannot be treated as zero use."
"The local write queue rejected %1$s tasks since clearing, causing missing samples. Collection does not cover every host page."

"Equal calendar-day windows are compared in local time, including unfinished today. Previous dates are retained, but uncovered pages, host exits, and collection gaps may still omit records. Count changes cannot be directly attributed to changed interests."

"Equal calendar-day windows are compared in local time, including unfinished today. The previous period predates recording/retention or includes known collection-off time, so no growth rate is calculated. Count changes cannot be directly attributed to changed interests."
